The '''Barma sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Dakshee]]. It bordered [[Haldeen sector/Legends|Haldeen sector]] and [[Kliap sector/Legends|Kliap sector]].
